claim: Patchline surfaces data-pipeline repair evidence beyond relational migrations: it recognizes destructive and structural data operations in Airflow DAGs, dbt models, Spark jobs, and Kafka consumers. Each framework is gated by a signal so prose and unrelated code are not misclassified, and destructive operations (table overwrites, dbt full-refresh/table materializations, Airflow backfills and dagrun resets, and Kafka offset resets) are recorded as searchable data_pipeline_change facts. This is proven against a real multi-framework lakehouse repository that combines Airflow orchestration, dbt transforms, and Spark overwrite writes, plus a deterministic four-framework unit matrix with a no-false-positive rule.
